title: Kissed Roasted English Cream Scones Clotted Cream
description: A nostalgic British dish featuring roasted scones and clotted cream, flavored with nutmeg and served in a stone bowl, perfect for a comforting snack. This recipe combines the warmth of roasted scones with the richness of clotted cream.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Add the cold butter to the dry ingredients and use a pastry blender or fingers to work it into the mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Make a well in the center of the mixture and add the heavy cream and egg, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a shaggy mass.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and gently knead it a few times until it comes together.
Pat the dough into a circle that is about 1 inch thick.
Use a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out scones, gathering the scraps and re-forming the dough as needed.
Place the scones on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the tops with a little extra heavy cream.
Roast the scones in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Split the scones in half horizontally and serve with clotted cream and a sprinkle of nutmeg.
